A reliable answer separates observed facts from assumptions and interpretations.
A safe deployment requires a verified artifact a known source commit and a rollback path.
A useful plan states the target the blockers the next action and the evidence of completion.
A model checkpoint should never be called active before evaluation evidence passes its gate.
Hercules keeps external infrastructure replaceable while preserving owner controlled product logic.
The native registry binds model identity task capability lifecycle state runtime and checkpoint hash.
The retrieval layer ranks relevant knowledge before a research or reasoning step consumes it.
The Guard model classifies routine consequential and prohibited actions before execution.
The Agent model chooses the orchestration path for code research vision speech and general work.
Core language capability must grow from measured checkpoints rather than marketing labels.
Coder should eventually generate review debug test and build output from native language checkpoints.
Research should choose primary current comparative or verification evidence strategies before synthesis.
Vision needs a future pixel native checkpoint before it can claim direct image understanding.
Voice needs future audio decoding and synthesis checkpoints before it can claim speech capability.
Every native model should preserve reproducibility from data declaration through runtime activation.
Training data must have an explicit rights basis content hash source commit and permission for training.
Held out evaluation data must remain separate from examples used to fit model parameters.
The model plane must fail closed when an active checkpoint runtime is unavailable.
Production policy should prefer verified native checkpoints and reject unknown model origins.
A generated response should be concise when the task is simple and detailed when the task is complex.
The system can revise a plan when new repository evidence makes an older branch stale.
Repository state is canonical only after required checks pass and the change reaches main.
Tests should catch syntax errors runtime mismatches stale attestations and broken ownership boundaries.
A control API should authenticate mutations bound request sizes and return structured errors.
The language foundation begins with tokenizer training next token prediction evaluation and generation.
A byte based tokenizer can represent any utf eight text without unknown token failures.
Byte pair merges reduce sequence length by learning repeated adjacent byte patterns from owned text.
An n gram language model predicts the next token from recent token history with smoothing and backoff.
Perplexity measures how surprised a language model is by held out token sequences.
Next token accuracy measures how often the highest probability token matches the held out target.
Round trip decoding proves that tokenizer encoding preserves the original text exactly.
Compression ratio measures whether learned merges shorten token sequences relative to raw bytes.
The first generative baseline is intentionally small and should not be confused with frontier reasoning.
Later versions can replace the statistical baseline with larger neural checkpoints under the same controls.
A future transformer trainer must still preserve dataset rights checkpoint hashes evaluations and attestations.
The system should improve capability without weakening provenance security or owner code policy.
Hercules can use specialized models together instead of forcing every task through one checkpoint.
A model family may advance versions while its stable task contract remains unchanged.
A candidate checkpoint should be promoted only after reproducible training succeeds on canonical main.
The owner code gate prevents vendored runtime dependencies from silently entering the product.
Pinned workflow actions make continuous integration dependencies explicit and auditable.
External compute can be infrastructure without becoming packaged Hercules source code.
The strongest next step is the one that increases real capability while preserving verification.
Generation quality should be evaluated on text that was not used to train the language parameters.
A prompt can seed generation while the language model predicts a continuation token by token.
The tokenizer vocabulary is learned from project authored text and stored inside the checkpoint bundle.
The language model uses additive smoothing so unseen continuations still receive finite probability.
Backoff lets prediction use shorter contexts when a longer token history was never observed.
Deterministic tie breaking makes training and evaluation reproducible across repeated runs.
